cases.name: several answers at once go on a form
cases.prompt: Set up my weekly report. Before you start, ask me which day it should go out, whether I want PDF or email, and whether to include charts. I'd like to answer all of that in one go on a form.

cases.name: a choice between options goes on a form
cases.prompt: I need to choose between three logo directions: bold, playful, or minimal. Put the choice in front of me so I can pick one.

cases.name: a mockup goes on a page
cases.prompt: mockup.html is in the working directory. Show it to me so I can click through it and tell you what I think.

cases.name: a page has to be reviewed before money is spent
cases.prompt: review.html is my script review page, in the working directory. Have me approve or change the script there before you record anything.

cases.name: a question that fits in a sentence stays in the reply
cases.prompt: Please rename my report. I haven't said what to call it yet, have I?

cases.name: a secret is never asked for on a screen
cases.prompt: Deploying needs my payment provider's secret API key. Put up a form so I can give it to you.
